title: Design System: AssurMatch Back-offices (admin and courtier)

title.purpose: Open page title only: light, semi-wide (width 114%).

section.purpose: Dialog and auth titles, attention counts (mono).

label.purpose: Uppercase, semi-condensed: section titles, nav groups, table headers, app tag.

data.purpose: References, identifiers, amounts, numeric cells in mono.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: User menu and dialogs only. The sole elevation shadow.

shadows.name: field-focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focus halo on inputs in the lead wavelength (danger-soft when invalid).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All hover and state transitions, 0.1 to 0.2s.

motion.name: scale-travel
motion.purpose: The ruler's lit tick tracks the scroll position; at rest under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button (bone plate)
components.description: The one solid action per view: bone fill, charcoal text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid oklch(0.93 0.012 95); border-radius:2px; background:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); color:oklch(0.175 0.004 250); font:600 14px/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch:94%; letter-spacing:0.02em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#fff; border-color:#fff; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.82 0.12 210); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent with a strong hairline for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-2 { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid oklch(0.43 0.008 250); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); font:600 14px/1.2 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch:94%; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-2:hover { background:oklch(0.275 0.006 250); border-color:oklch(0.67 0.012 95); } .ds-btn-2:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.82 0.12 210); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset charcoal field with a control-line border; the lead wavelength lights on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; } .ds-field-label { font:600 14px/1.25 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch:94%; color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); } .ds-input { min-height:38px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid oklch(0.6 0.01 250); border-radius:2px; background:oklch(0.145 0.004 250); color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); font:15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color-scheme:dark; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:oklch(0.8 0.012 95); } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:oklch(0.82 0.12 210); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.27 0.045 210); }

components.name: Navigation Tick Rail
components.description: Each entry owns a short tick; the open entry extends it to a long lit line.
components.html: Tableau de bordDossiersCourtiers
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:1px; width:256px; padding:16px 0; background:oklch(0.15 0.004 250); } .ds-nav-link { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:34px; padding:6px 16px 6px 44px; color:oklch(0.8 0.012 95); font:500 14px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:50%; left:0; width:34px; height:1px; background:oklch(0.43 0.008 250); transform:scaleX(0.3); transform-origin:left center; transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background:oklch(0.275 0.006 250); color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); } .ds-nav-link:hover::before { transform:scaleX(0.55); background:oklch(0.67 0.012 95); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { background:oklch(0.225 0.005 250); color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page']::before { transform:scaleX(1); height:2px; background:oklch(0.82 0.12 210); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.82 0.12 210); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Emission Badge
components.description: A mark plus a label, no fill: solid, dashed, double, half-height, struck.
components.html: Valide En attente Bloque Information Desactive
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:24px; color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); font:500 14px/1.25 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch:94%; } .ds-badge::before { content:''; flex:none; width:3px; height:14px; background:var(--mark); } .ds-ok { --mark:oklch(0.8 0.18 150); } .ds-warn { --mark:oklch(0.87 0.17 95); } .ds-warn::before { background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--mark) 0 4px, transparent 4px 6px); } .ds-bad { --mark:oklch(0.7 0.2 25); } .ds-bad::before { width:7px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--mark) 0 3px, transparent 3px 4px, var(--mark) 4px 7px); } .ds-info { --mark:oklch(0.75 0.13 250); } .ds-info::before { height:8px; } .ds-off { --mark:oklch(0.67 0.012 95); color:oklch(0.67 0.012 95); text-decoration:line-through; } .ds-off::before { width:10px; height:1px; }

components.css: .ds-card { width:640px; border:1px solid oklch(0.31 0.006 250); border-radius:3px; background:oklch(0.225 0.005 250); color:oklch(0.93 0.012 95); font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(120px,1fr) 5ch; align-items:center; gap:16px; min-height:64px; padding:12px 16px; border-top:1px solid oklch(0.31 0.006 250); } .ds-row:first-child { border-top:0; } .ds-row:hover { background:oklch(0.2 0.005 250); } .ds-row-label { font-size:15px; font-weight:600; } .ds-row-help { font-size:14px; color:oklch(0.67 0.012 95); } .ds-scale { position:relative; height:28px; border-bottom:1px solid oklch(0.43 0.008 250); background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.43 0.008 250) 0 1px, transparent 1px 25%) left bottom / 100% 6px no-repeat; } .ds-line { position:absolute; bottom:0; left:calc(var(--share) * 100%); height:24px; width:3px; margin-left:-1px; } .ds-line-bad { width:7px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.7 0.2 25) 0 3px, transparent 3px 4px, oklch(0.7 0.2 25) 4px 7px); } .ds-line-warn { background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(0.87 0.17 95) 0 4px, transparent 4px 6px); } .ds-line-info { height:14px; background:oklch(0.75 0.13 250); } .ds-count { font:400 20px 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-align:right; }

components.name: Page Ruler
components.description: The sticky 22px graduated scale across the top of every page, with a lit tick in the app's lead wavelength.
components.css: .ds-ruler { position:relative; width:640px; height:22px; border-bottom:1px solid oklch(0.31 0.006 250); background-color:oklch(0.175 0.004 250); background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.43 0.008 250) 0 1px, transparent 1px 8px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.67 0.012 95) 0 1px, transparent 1px 64px); background-position:left bottom, left bottom; background-size:100% 6px, 100% 12px; background-repeat:no-repeat; } .ds-ruler-mark { position:absolute; bottom:0; left:35%; width:2px; height:22px; margin-left:-1px; background:oklch(0.82 0.12 210); }

narrative.overview:
A spectrogram lying on a viewing box. The ground is a charcoal continuum, the plates are slightly lighter ash, the legends are bone. Colour is not a surface here: it exists only as thin emission lines, the way a spectral line sits on a dark band. State is carried by the form of the line (solid, dashed, double, half-height, struck), so every status reads with the hue removed; the hue only repeats the form.

The system is one build for two apps. Admin and courtier share every token and component and are told apart by their lead wavelength (admin cyan, courtier violet, selected by data-app on the root) and by the app tag in the rail. It is dark only, dense and desk-oriented, with a 14px floor for every text. It refuses the default back-office: light grey panels, pastel status pills, a card grid of KPIs.

This replaces the earlier light "standard SaaS" back-office entirely. It is a replacement world, not an extension of it.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal ground, ash plates, bone ink; no colour fills anywhere except the primary action's bone plate.
State grammar by line form; hue is redundancy.
A ruler across every page and a tick rail in the navigation both express position.
One grotesque (Archivo) at different widths; mono (Spline Sans Mono) for data.
Square 2 to 4px corners; shadows on popovers only; native controls rendered dark.

rules.name: The Emission Only Rule
rules.body: Hue appears as a line, a mark or an icon glyph, never as a filled surface. If you reach for a coloured background, draw a line instead.

rules.name: The Form Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Every state must be distinguishable in greyscale: solid is success, dashed is warning, double is danger (do first), half-height is info or neutral, struck is disabled. The hue repeats the form and never replaces it.

rules.name: The One Wavelength Rule
rules.body: An app has one lead wavelength (cyan or violet). Do not use it for state, and do not mix both in a screen.

rules.name: The 14px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set below 14px; compact means narrower width, not smaller size. Form fields go to 16px on phones.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Mono is for figures, references and amounts only. Prose, labels and buttons stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Width Is Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight (wide and light up top, condensed and semibold in tables), not from adding families.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Quantities that compare must sit on one scale. The attention list positions each queue's line at its share of the largest queue; do not size each row independently.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Boxed Rule
rules.body: Group with hairlines and spacing; a table or filter bar inside a card inherits the card frame instead of adding a second border.

rules.name: The Popover Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "floats above the page". Nothing that sits in the flow gets one.

dos: Do express every state with the line grammar (solid, dashed, double, half-height, struck) and let the hue repeat it.
Do keep the primary action a bone plate with charcoal text, one per view.
Do set figures, references and amounts in Spline Sans Mono with tabular numerals; set titles light and wide, tables semi-condensed.
Do keep text at 14px or above, with ink-3 as the lowest text tone on plates.
Do use hairlines (1px line) and the 4px spacing scale to group; keep corners at 2, 3 or 4px.
Do keep native controls dark (color-scheme: dark) and give every interactive element the 2px lead-wavelength focus ring.
Do put the ruler on every page and let the open nav entry carry the long lit tick.
Do honour reduced motion: the ruler mark rests at its section position and transitions are removed.
donts: Don't fill a surface, pill or row with a state colour; state is never a coloured background.
Don't use a border-left or border-right stripe wider than 1px as an accent; the only thick lines are the 2px underlines of the app tag, active tab and active nav tick.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above titles (the legacy kicker class is retired and hidden).
Don't add shadows to anything in the flow; shadows belong to popovers and dialogs.
Don't introduce a light theme or a theme switch; the build is dark only until a light variant is specified.
Don't round things (beyond 4px) other than avatars, counters and the switch.
Don't add a second type family, or set prose in mono.
Don't mix both lead wavelengths on one screen, or use the lead wavelength to signal state.
Don't read the public site's tokens or styles; the back-office stylesheet is bo- scoped and self-contained.
